headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 9, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees. Cole tossed 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom hitting a home run and driving in one run in four at-bats.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Williamson's injury will require a minimum 10-day recovery period. Other players on the injured list include Seattle Mariners pitcher Cole Wilcox, Minnesota Twins pitcher Joe Ryan, Cleveland Guardians pitcher Slade Cecconi, Chicago White Sox pitcher Chris Murphy, Chicago White Sox catcher Joey Bart, and Toronto Blue Jays second baseman Luis Urías.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that has yet to be disclosed in full details. Other notable trades include the Athletics acquiring pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, the Miami Marlins trading pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates, and the Colorado Rockies trading pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, tossing 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Out Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit a home run, his sixth of the season, and drove in two runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's injury will require a minimum 10-day recovery period.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that has yet to be disclosed in full details.
